text: FIREFthreads is an option for FIRECreateConfigFile and other functions of the FIRE interface.

It specifies the #fthreads parameter to be set in a FIRE .config-file. The default value is twice times the number of physical cores ($ProcessorCount) on your machine with the separate FERMAT mode being active.
